subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or repair the open fork cleanup PR as the fix path, replace it with a fresh narrow PR, or close that candidate and reject this cleanup?
rationale: The source-level bug remains, but a closing fork PR already exists, so duplicate automated fix work should pause until maintainers choose the implementation path.

options.title: Review or replace the open cleanup PR
options.body: Use the fork PR if it can be refreshed with proof, or open a narrow replacement that preserves the same Google Chat lifecycle boundary.

options.title: Close the fork PR and keep this issue queued
options.body: Close the stale implementation candidate but leave this issue as the canonical source-repro bug for a future fix.

options.title: Reject the cleanup behavior
options.body: Close the candidate and this issue only if maintainers decide stale Google Chat placeholders after NO_REPLY are acceptable or unsupported.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the open cleanup PR
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR if it can be refreshed with proof, or open a narrow replacement that preserves the same Google Chat lifecycle boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat reply-delivery and plugin lifecycle history makes this the best available owner for choosing the cleanup path.
